description: ML-KEM-768 known-answer tests from NIST ACVP internalProjection.json (commit 65370b8). AFT vectors (tcIds 26-28): decapsulation positive KATs. VAL vectors (tgId=5, tcIds 86-95): shared dk; 'modify ciphertext' cases verify implicit rejection (FIPS 203 §6.3) — decapsulate returns pseudorandom K' rather than signalling failure; 'no modification' cases verify normal decapsulation.
m_usage_note: The m field is NIST ACVP encapsulation randomness used to reproduce c and k in the source KAT. Runtime decapsulation consumers must not require m.
